name: Breath Awareness Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Settle into a comfortable seated position, lengthening your spine and relaxing your shoulders.
Take three slow, deep breaths to signal your body it's time to settle in.
Let your breath return to its natural pace, and rest your attention on one spot where you feel it most — the nostrils, chest, or belly.
Silently note "in" and "out" with each breath to help anchor your focus.
When thoughts arise, acknowledge them without judgment and gently return to the breath.
Continue for the full 10 minutes, gradually widening your awareness to the room before opening your eyes.
